# `bitmap_bucket_number`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the bucket number for the given input child expression.

**Applies to:** not available in Krishiv yet. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
bitmap_bucket_number(child)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Not implemented yet |
| Group | `misc_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- bitmap_bucket_number, example 1
> SELECT bitmap_bucket_number(123);
Error: KRISHIV_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE
```

```sql
-- bitmap_bucket_number, example 2
> SELECT bitmap_bucket_number(0);
Error: KRISHIV_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE
```
